name: mushroom
description: A mushroom, from a 18 cm fly agaric in the woods to a giant fantasy toadstool: a lathed stem with a bulbous foot and a scaly volva, a hanging ring, a cap that blends from a dome to a flat plate or a bell, gills underneath as fine radial ridges, warts in seeded rings that follow the cap, and small sprouts at the foot. Three styles: a red fly agaric with white warts, a brown cep, and a violet fantasy mushroom with glowing gills and spots.

params.name: height
params.description: Total height in metres: 0.05-0.3 is a real mushroom, 1-6 a giant fantasy one.

params.name: capWidth
params.description: Cap width relative to the usual (1: the cap is about 3/4 of the height across).

params.name: stemThickness
params.description: Stem thickness relative to the usual (2 is a fat cep stem).

params.name: style
params.description: 1 fly agaric (red, white warts), 2 cep (brown), 3 fantasy (violet, glowing gills and warts).

params.name: ring
params.description: The hanging ring (annulus) on the stem.

params.name: sprouts
params.description: Small young mushrooms at the foot.

params.name: tilt
params.description: Tilt of the cap in degrees (forward is positive).

params.name: seed
params.description: Seed for the warts and the sprouts.
